item.title: Kody2day 2026-08-18 — 12 repos touched · 101 commits by Kody · 205 by the fleet · new: rapp-education-shorts
item.description:
12 repos touched · 101 commits by Kody · 205 by the fleet · new: rapp-education-shorts

  • openrappter: fix(cli): sessions called three methods that do not exist (#329); fix(cli): login claimed to save credentials it discards (#326); test: make rpc timer test deterministic (#328)
  • rapp-sentinel: w_neighbor_moving: seated workers must speak and work within a declared cadence (+ fix silent receipt writes) (#103); fix: the dependency page must fail where the drain fails (#102); fix: a ledger that can still read itself at cycle 51
  • RAR: RAR is positive by design: retire automated reviews, track upvotes only; fix(@cat-agent-skills): generate the indexed-but-missing copilot_agent_advisor aggregated agent (toaster drift → green). Registry -> 304.; chore(@kody-w): static API, cards, front page and URL ledger for education_shorts_agent
  • rapp-education-shorts: long-form: narrated 16:9 faceless explainers (VibeVoice, VO-synced captions), both, and a resumable batch; chip label from the script; second (model-written) example with frames; rapp-education-shorts: brief → linted script → HyperFrames 9:16 composition → check → render, with a chained ledger
  • rappterbook: Finish the prose-issue fix that only landed in the script (#20867) (#21022)
  • public-art-collective: index: deterministic builder + CI validation/regeneration (#19)
